tool.name: OpenReadout export
tool.description: raw instrument files to OME-TIFF, OME-Zarr, mzML, CSV or Parquet
tool.command: @LINK_INPUT@ openreadout export '$input_name' --to '$target.to' #if $target.to == 'ome-tiff' -o out.ome.tiff --compression '$target.compression' --pyramid '$target.pyramid' #if str($target.image) != '' --image $target.image #end if #elif $target.to == 'ome-zarr' -o out.ome.zarr --pyramid '$target.pyramid' #if str($target.image) != '' --image $target.image #end if #elif $target.to == 'mzml' -o out.mzML $target.centroid #elif $target.to == 'csv' -o out.csv #if str($target.table) != '' --table $target.table #end if #if str($target.trace) != '' --trace $target.trace #end if #if str($target.sweep) != '' --sweep $target.sweep #end if $target.labels #elif $target.to == 'parquet' -o out.parquet #if str($target.table) != '' --table $target.table #end if #if str($target.trace) != '' --trace $target.trace #end if $target.spectra #end if --json > '$report' #if $target.to == 'ome-tiff' && mv out.ome.tiff '$ome_tiff' #elif $target.to == 'ome-zarr' && zip -q -r -X out.ome.zarr.zip out.ome.zarr && mv out.ome.zarr.zip '$ome_zarr' #elif $target.to == 'mzml' && mv out.mzML '$mzml' #elif $target.to == 'csv' && mv out.csv '$csv' #elif $target.to == 'parquet' && mv out.parquet '$parquet' #end if

param.name: to
param.label: Export to
param.option: CSV (a table or one trace sweep)
Parquet (a table, a trace or mass spectra)

param.name: image
param.label: Only this image (0 = the first)
param.help: Default: every image of the file

param.name: centroid
param.label: Write the instrument's centroid lists where scans store both

param.name: table
param.label: Table (0 = the first)
param.help: FCS data set, plate read, event table

param.name: sweep
param.label: Sweep of the trace (0 = the first)

param.name: labels
param.label: Add a second header line with the column labels (FCS $PnS)

tool.help:
**What it does**
Converts a raw instrument file to an open format, without the vendor's software:
- **OME-TIFF**: images (CZI, ND2, LIF, OIR, VSI, whole-slide TIFF, ...) as BigTIFF with OME-XML metadata; pyramidal and tiled when the source has a pyramid. - **OME-Zarr**: OME-NGFF 0.5 (Zarr v3) with a multiscale pyramid, delivered as a zip archive of the ``.ome.zarr`` directory. - **mzML**: every mass spectrum (Thermo RAW, Bruker timsTOF, mzXML, ...) as indexed mzML 1.1. - **CSV**: one table (FCS events, plate reads) or one sweep of a trace (electrophysiology, chromatograms, NMR and IR spectra) in physical units. - **Parquet**: a table, a trace or the mass spectra, with units and labels in the column metadata.
Every output is written under a temporary name, read back and compared with the source, and only then delivered; the report says ``"verified": true``.
Indices (image, table, trace, sweep) start at 0, as in the OpenReadout metadata.
@HELP_FOOTER@
